chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Going west with Red Allen: Chicago and the 331 Club
summary: He and Red Allen spent years between Chicago and California, ending at the 331 Club on Wilshire Boulevard.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: What happened in that ten-year period till the time you got married?
Oh, we were just friends.
That was 20 years, right, because it was like '35 to '55?
Well, as I say, he was married and I was married. I was living in Long Island... Then he and his wife - then Jay went away, he and Red Allen, and went to the Coast - Chicago
and from Chicago out to the Coast. He stayed out there for quite a few years, didn't you, with Red Allen?
Sure did.
He stayed out in Chicago?
Between Chicago and California they were traveling. That's when he was with Red Allen.
Were you playing with Red Allen in Chicago? I mean, who had the band, Red Allen?
We quit. We stayed out there - I mean we stayed so long we just quit. About 3 years and then we went to the 331 Club in California, and that was too long.
During this time you were - ?
Wilshire Boulevard.
When you were out there in Chicago with Red, who was in that band?
(HUMS) Joe (Riley?); he was the manager. he's dead; Al Winters.
Joe Garland; he's a monk.
Really? Where?
Where did he go... monastery. I think that's what Red Allen told me.
John Kirby...
They worked all around in the Chicago area, like Kansas City and Milwaukee?
Yeah. Then he left and went to Cleveland.
